entities.summary: Wolfgang Francis Novogratz is an American actor and model. He has appeared in the Netflix films Sierra Burgess Is a Loser (2018), The Last Summer (2019), The Half of It (2020) and Feel the Beat (2020). He also appeared in the film Yes, God, Yes (2019).
